blocks.text: ILOILO CITY – As he walked toward the Rizal Ceremonial Hall at Malacañang Palace, each footfall seemed to echo the rivers he had crossed, the steep mountain trails he had climbed, and the long roads he had walked as a teacher to reach children in far-flung barangays. Then came his name. “Daryl B. Arguelles, School Principal 2, Bagtasan Elementary School, Department of Education Antique, for his dedication in bringing educational opportunities to the farthest barangays in Bugasong, Antique.” READ: Marcos hails teachers, vows prioritization of education sector The words marked the moment he became a Dangal ng Bayan awardee of the […]...
